scenes.say: Imagine this. You're getting solar now, and you might want a battery in a few years.
Your inverter choice today really matters.
A grid-tie inverter converts solar power, but shuts down in outages and can't manage a battery.
A hybrid inverter handles both solar and a battery, and can provide backup.
If a battery might come later, a hybrid inverter or battery-ready design can save money.
Already have solar? AC-coupled batteries are the easiest to add.
Choosing an inverter? Read the free guide at viva voltia dot com.
